_note: Who had law where. 'organized' is the date from which county government and sheriffs are possible in the sim; before it a camp has a miners' meeting or a town marshal its citizens hire. Black Hills: Sioux treaty land until Congress ratified the Manypenny Agreement on 1877-02-28 (verified); Lawrence County seated at Deadwood in 1877 (Britannica). Wyoming Territory was organized in 1868 (from memory, July; not confirmed this session).
